Through the fog came a voice he remembered perfectly: You always did leave things until the last minute.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把空荡的街道照得微黄，清洁工推着车，扫过昨夜留下的落叶。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃缓缓上升。远处，一辆货车驶过桥面，声音很快隐入薄雾。有人刚刚下班，有人准备出发。天边还没有亮，生活已经轻轻翻过一页。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same steps on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you reach a toy.\n- A recursive program needs a stopping rule, just like stopping when there are no more boxes."}
